subject: English
title: CBSE English, Class I

source.read: NCERT, Learning Outcomes at the Elementary Stage (2017), English section, read through a copy hosted by the Indian Education Repository (CPR India); CBSE circular 05/2019 asks schools to use it; Class I list
source.note: UNOFFICIAL SOURCE. A copy of the NCERT document, read through a text summary of the PDF, not the PDF itself. The class books have since changed (Mridang for Classes 1-2, Santoor for 3-5, Poorvi for 6-8, under NCF-SE 2023); their chapters are not listed here and a school may order or extend these outcomes.

licence: Strand names as printed (facts). Every outcome is written by OpenPath in its own words; no curriculum or textbook text is reproduced.
review: OpenPath curriculum inventory (AI-assisted research from secondary sources; not an educator review)

outcomes.text: Says rhymes and poems with actions.
outcomes.note: Done aloud with a grown-up, who ticks what they heard. The app cannot hear or mark speaking.

outcomes.text: Answers simple questions about a story heard, in any language.
outcomes.note: Answers are chosen on screen in English; answering aloud or in a home language is not heard.

outcomes.text: Names the characters of a story, says what happened in order, and asks about it.
outcomes.note: Done aloud with a grown-up, who ticks what they heard. The app cannot hear or mark speaking.
First words gives tap-this-then-that instructions by ear; classroom instructions are not in the app.

outcomes.text: Answers greetings and polite words in English.
outcomes.note: Done aloud with a grown-up, who ticks what they heard. The app cannot hear or mark speaking.

outcomes.text: Talks about self, a situation or a picture.
outcomes.note: Done aloud with a grown-up, who ticks what they heard. The app cannot hear or mark speaking.

outcomes.text: Matches words with pictures and names objects in pictures.
Knows the letters A to Z and the sounds they make.
outcomes.note: First words says each word aloud with its picture; letter-by-letter sound work is not in the app.

outcomes.text: Tells small letters from capital letters.
outcomes.note: Capital letters are practised at the start of sentences; matching each small letter to its capital is not.

outcomes.text: Sounds out common blends such as br and fr.
outcomes.note: The Spelling Bee teaches spelling by sound; blends are not taught on their own.

outcomes.text: Draws or scribbles in answer to poems and stories.
outcomes.note: Done with a grown-up, away from the app, who ticks what they saw.

outcomes.text: Writes simple words such as fan, hen and rat.
Writes letters and words clearly by hand.
outcomes.note: Done with a grown-up, away from the app, who ticks what they saw.

outcomes.text: Uses naming words for people and things.
